Strawberry Nutella Brownies 🍓🤎 Perfect brownies for summer!  (recipe makes an 8x8 pan) Ingredients:  10 tbsp (140g) unsalted butter, melted 1 cup (200g) granulated sugar ¼ cup (50g) brown sugar, packed  2 eggs, room temp 1 tsp vanilla extract ½ cup + 2 tbsp (56g) unsweetened cocoa powder ½ tsp salt 1 tbsp (13g) vegetable oil ½ cup (63g) all purpose flour, spooned & leveled or weighed (don’t pack it in) ¾ cup chocolate chips 190g (~⅔ cup) Nutella  Topping: Strawberry slices, patted dry (as many as you want/enough to cover the top) Nutella (to spread over the top & drizzle)  Instructions: Line an 8x8 pan with parchment paper. Spread the nutella onto the parchment into a thin, even square the size of the pan. Freeze for at least 30 minutes or until frozen solid. Preheat oven to 325°F and line/grease an 8x8 pan with parchment. In a large bowl, whisk melted butter, granulated sugar, and brown sugar until smooth. Add eggs and vanilla, then whisk vigorously for 1-2 minutes. Stir in cocoa powder and salt until fully combined. Mix in oil, then gently fold in the flour until just combined (don’t over mix). Fold in chocolate chips. Spread half the batter into the greased pan. Place the frozen nutella sheet on top of it. Then, spread the remaining batter over it to cover the nutella layer completely. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until a toothpick near the center comes out with no wet batter. It should just come out with a little nutella & slightly moist crumbs. Let the brownies cool completely. Spread a thin layer of nutella over the cooled brownies, add strawberry slices (patted dry) all over the top, and drizzle with more nutella.  Best enjoyed fresh!  #bakingrecipe #brownies #chocolatestrawberries #nutella #recipe

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Creamy Garlic Parmesan Penne with Steak, Broccoli & Bell Peppers 🥩🧄🥦🫑🧀🍝 Tender penne pasta tossed with juicy seared steak, crisp-tender broccoli, and sweet bell peppers in a rich garlic Parmesan cream sauce. This skillet dinner is bold, comforting, and loaded with steakhouse flavor—ready in just 30 minutes! 🥩🧄🧀🍝🔥 📝 Ingredients: 12 oz penne pasta 1.25 lb sirloin or ribeye steak, cut into bite-size pieces Salt & black pepper, to taste 1 tsp garlic powder 2 tbsp olive oil 3 tbsp unsalted butter 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup beef or chicken broth 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese 1 tsp Italian seasoning 1 cup broccoli florets, blanched 1 red bell pepper, sliced 1 green bell pepper, sliced 2 tbsp fresh parsley, chopped 🔥 Instructions: 1. Cook the Penne: Boil penne in salted water until al dente. Drain and set aside. 2. Sear the Steak: Season steak with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear steak 1–2 minutes per side until browned. Remove and set aside. 3. Sauté the Veggies: In the same skillet, add butter and garlic. Sauté for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. Add broccoli and bell peppers; cook 3–4 minutes until crisp-tender. 4. Make the Garlic Parmesan Sauce: Stir in heavy cream, broth, and Parmesan. Simmer 2–3 minutes until thick and creamy. Add Italian seasoning. 5. Combine Everything: Return steak and penne to the skillet. Toss until fully coated in the creamy sauce. 6. Finish & Serve: Garnish with parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Serve hot. ⏱ Prep Time: 10 minutes 🔥 Cook Time: 20 minutes ⏲️ Total Time: 30 minutes 🍽 Servings: 4 🥩🧄 Creamy, garlicky, and loaded with steakhouse flavor—this penne skillet with steak, broccoli, and peppers is the ultimate weeknight indulgence! 🥦🫑🧀🔥

Cinnamon rolls… made in 20 minutes, and every bite is the center of the cinnamon Roll In depth recipe with pictures on substack!!! 🛒 Ingredients Dough 1 cup (130g) all purpose flour 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt 1 tsp cinnamon 1/3 cup (80ml) milk (or half milk, half heavy cream) 1 tsp vanilla 1 tbsp melted butter Coating 1 tbsp melted butter 3 tbsp sugar 1-2 tsp cinnamon Vanilla Bean Glaze ✨ 4 tbsp powdered sugar 2 tsp heavy cream 1/2 tsp vanilla Vanilla bean or vanilla bean paste 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1️⃣ Preheat oven to 375°F and grease or line your pan 2️⃣ In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon 3️⃣ Warm milk slightly, then mix in vanilla and melted butter 4️⃣ Pour wet into dry and mix until a soft dough forms, stop as soon as it comes together, don’t overmix 5️⃣ Lightly flour your surface, roll dough into a log, flatten slightly, and cut into 20 even bites 6️⃣ Toss each piece in melted butter, then coat fully in cinnamon sugar 7️⃣ Place in pan in a single layer with a little space between each, no stacking 8️⃣ Bake 9 to 10 minutes, until lightly golden, don’t overbake 9️⃣ While baking, mix glaze until smooth, adjust thickness if needed 🔟 Let bites cool 1 to 2 minutes, drizzle glaze over the top while warm, and enjoy ⏱ Time & Servings Prep 10 min Cook 10 min Serves 2 to 3 🔥 Pro Tip Mix just until the dough comes together, overmixing is what makes these dense instead of soft and pillowy. School Nights in the Slow Cooker  Part 4 | Crockpot Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo  This is one of those easy dinners that feels like comfort food but is simple enough for a busy school night! Ingredients 1–1½ lbs chicken breast ½ sweet onion, diced ½ cup shredded carrots Chicka Licka Bam Bam Chicken Rub, to taste @Fire & Smoke Society  ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 2 tsp chicken bouillon powder ½ tsp paprika ¼ tsp black pepper 1½ cups chicken broth 2 cups broccoli 1 cup orzo 1 (8 oz) block cheddar cheese, freshly shredded plus more for topping  ½ cup heavy cream Salt, to taste at the end Directions 1. Add the chicken, diced onion, shredded carrots, chicken rub, garlic powder, onion powder, chicken bouillon powder, paprika, black pepper, and chicken broth to your slow cooker. 2. Cover and cook on LOW for 4–5 hours or HIGH for 2–3 hours, until the chicken is cooked through and tender. 3. Remove the chicken, shred or chop it, and return it to the slow cooker. 4. Stir in the orzo, broccoli, heavy cream, and shredded cheddar. Cover and cook on HIGH for about 30 minutes, stirring once or twice, until the orzo is tender. Keep an eye on it toward the end since orzo can absorb liquid quickly. 5. Taste before adding any salt. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

🥩 Oven-Roasted BBQ Brisket 🍖 This Oven-Roasted BBQ Brisket is slow-cooked until irresistibly tender, then finished with a rich, sticky barbecue glaze that caramelizes beautifully in the oven. Every slice is juicy, smoky, and packed with bold flavor, making it the perfect centerpiece for family dinners, weekend gatherings, or holiday meals. Ingredients For the Brisket • 4–5 lbs beef brisket, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp garlic powder • 2 tsp onion powder • 1½ tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chili powder • ½ tsp ground cumin For the Roasting Base • 1 large onion, sliced • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup beef broth • 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce For the BBQ Glaze • 1½ cups barbecue sauce, divided • 2 tbsp brown sugar • 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 300°F (150°C). Arrange the sliced onion and minced garlic in the bottom of a large roasting pan or Dutch oven. 2. Pat the brisket dry with paper towels, then rub it all over with olive oil. 3. In a small bowl, combine the smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, black pepper, chili powder, and cumin. Rub the seasoning mixture evenly over every side of the brisket. 4. Place the brisket fat-side up on top of the onions. Pour the beef broth and Worcestershire sauce around the meat. 5. Cover the pan tightly with a lid or heavy-duty aluminum foil and roast for 4½–5 hours, or until the brisket is fork-tender. 6. In a bowl, whisk together 1 cup of the barbecue sauce, brown sugar, and apple cider vinegar. 7. Remove the brisket from the oven and generously brush the top with the barbecue glaze. 8. Increase the oven temperature to 425°F (220°C). Return the brisket to the oven uncovered and roast for another 10–15 minutes, until the glaze becomes glossy, caramelized, and slightly charred around the edges. 9. Transfer the brisket to a cutting board and let it rest for 20 minutes before slicing thinly against the grain. 10. Drizzle the sliced brisket with the flavorful pan juices and serve with the remaining barbecue sauce. Serving Suggestions Serve with creamy mashed potatoes, baked beans, buttery cornbread, roasted corn on the cob, coleslaw, mac and cheese, or grilled vegetables for a classic Southern-style barbecue feast. Storage Store leftover brisket in an airtight container with a little extra barbecue sauce in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat gently in the oven or on the stovetop to keep the meat tender and juicy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 5 hours Total Time: 5 hours 35 minutes Servings: 8 Calories: Approximately 520 per serving #BBQBrisket #ComfortFood #EasyDinner #FamilyMeals #SlowRoasted

This Banana Omelet Tastes Like French Toast 🍳 🍌 ⸻ Ingredients ▶️ 1 ripe banana (120 g) ▶️ 2 large eggs ▶️ 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon ▶️ 1/2 tsp vanilla powder ▶️ Small pinch of sea salt ▶️ 1 tsp butter or extra-virgin olive oil (for the pan) ⸻ Preparation 1. Peel the banana and mash it in a bowl until mostly smooth. 2. Add the eggs, cinnamon, vanilla powder, and sea salt. 3. Whisk until well combined. 4. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium-low heat and lightly grease it with the butter or olive oil. 5. Pour the mixture into the skillet and spread it into an even circle. 6. Cook for 3–4 minutes, until the bottom is golden and the top is mostly set. 7. Carefully flip the omelet with a wide spatula and cook for another 2–3 minutes, until fully cooked through. 8. Fold the omelet in half and serve warm. ⸻ Tips (For Best Results) 💡 Use a ripe banana: The riper the banana, the sweeter and more French toast-like the flavor. 💡 Cook over medium-low heat: This allows the eggs to cook through without burning the banana. 💡 Mash the banana well: A smoother mixture creates a more even texture. 💡 Use a non-stick skillet: It makes flipping much easier. 💡 Flip gently: Wait until the omelet is mostly set before turning it over. 💡 Customize the toppings: Serve with fresh berries, Greek yogurt, chopped nuts, or a drizzle of honey. 💡 Enjoy immediately: The texture is best while warm. ⸻ Nutrition (1 omelet) ✅ Calories: ~260 kcal ✅ Protein: ~14 g ✅ Carbs: ~25 g ✅ Fat: ~11 g ✅ Fiber: ~3 g #bananaomelet #healthybreakfast #highproteinbreakfast #healthyfood #recipe
